IT SUPPORT SERVICES AGREEMENT

This Agreement is made between UK Company Ltd (the "Customer") and Vendor A Test Ltd (the "Supplier").

1. Definitions
1.1 In this Agreement, "Personal Data" has the meaning given in the UK GDPR.

2. Services
2.1 The Supplier shall provide first and second line IT support to the Customer's staff from its delivery centre in Bengaluru, India.

3. Service Levels
3.1 The Supplier shall respond to priority 1 incidents within 30 minutes and resolve them within 4 hours.
3.2 The Supplier shall maintain availability of the service desk of 99.5% each month. Service credits apply where a service level is missed.

4. Data Protection
4.1 The Supplier shall process Personal Data only on the documented instructions of the Customer and in accordance with Data Protection Legislation.
4.2 The Supplier shall ensure that persons authorised to process Personal Data are bound by confidentiality.

5. Security
5.1 The Supplier shall implement appropriate technical and organisational measures, including encryption, multi-factor authentication and access controls, to protect Personal Data.

6. Personal Data Breach
6.1 The Supplier shall notify the Customer without undue delay and in any event within 24 hours of becoming aware of a Personal Data Breach.

7. Sub-processors
7.1 The Supplier shall not engage any sub-processor without the prior written consent of the Customer, and shall impose the same data protection obligations on any sub-processor.

8. International Transfers
8.1 The Supplier shall not transfer Personal Data outside the United Kingdom except to India, and only under the International Data Transfer Agreement or another appropriate safeguard.

9. Audit
9.1 The Customer may audit the Supplier's compliance with this Agreement on 30 days' written notice, no more than once in any 12 month period.

10. Term and Termination
10.1 Either party may terminate this Agreement on 90 days' written notice.
10.2 On termination, the Supplier shall return or securely delete all Personal Data within 30 days and certify the deletion in writing.

11. Liability
11.1 Each party's total liability under this Agreement shall not exceed the fees paid in the 12 months before the claim.

12. Governing Law
12.1 This Agreement is governed by the laws of England and Wales.
